page: OVHcloud r3-128 is a memory-optimized server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC processor running at 2.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core. Local storage is provided by a 400 GB NVMe SSD, and the network interface delivers a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong memory performance, with the PassMark memory score reaching the top 10% tier. Large-block memory bandwidth for both read and write operations ranks in the top 25%, alongside strong single-core CPU performance in stress-ng and Geekbench. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and text processing also perform in the top 25%. Multi-core CPU metrics, database operations, and Redis SET operations fall within the average range.

Given its dedicated AMD EPYC cores and high memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance offers qualitative resource density for memory-bound workloads without the overhead of hyperthreading. It is suited for memory-intensive applications, database hosting, caching layers, and medium-scale data processing tasks that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation and local NVMe storage.
